note: Adapted production hardening for the pinned fixed-instance/single-memory interpreter. The pinned Node configuration disables the V8 sandbox, where SBXCHECK expands to DCHECK; use unconditional CHECK for the adapted ownership/bounds guards. This does not enable or claim V8 sandbox isolation. No upstream mjsunit.status skips are applied. Newer InstanceScope, multi-memory vectors, TrustedCast and WasmFuncRef-only ExecuteCallRef API are absent in this source; retain its actual ABI and valid legacy reference-call paths. Runtime/native adversarial acceptance is not inferred from source hashes.
